checks.description: The layout renders right-to-left correctly; mixed Arabic, English, or numerals do not break direction, alignment, or reading order.
checks.rule: Fail when Arabic content is not right-to-left, when alignment or reading order is broken, or when mixed Latin text or numerals flip the direction.

checks.description: Color matches the brand constants: near-black background #141414, card surfaces #1A1A1A, primary accent emerald #009975, used as a highlight not a flood.
checks.rule: Fail when background, surface, or accent color departs from the constants, or when the emerald accent floods the composition instead of highlighting.

checks.description: Any numerals shown in rendered text are Western 0 to 9, never Eastern Arabic numerals.
checks.rule: Scan rendered text for Eastern Arabic-Indic digits (U+0660 to U+0669). Any occurrence is a fail; the fix substitutes the Western numeral.

checks.description: No Arabic text is baked into a generated image; copy is a real overlay in the asset brief's copy-overlay slots.
checks.rule: Fail when any Arabic text is rendered inside a generated image. Copy-overlay slots stay empty for copywriter-ar; text is never baked into the generated pixels.

checks.description: Declared dimensions and safe areas are present and respected, with no critical content clipped by platform crops.
checks.rule: Fail when dimensions or safe areas are missing from the spec, or when critical content sits outside the safe area and is clipped by a platform crop.

checks.description: The result is premium and uncluttered: generous space, clear hierarchy, no visual noise.
checks.rule: Fail when the composition is cluttered, crowded, or lacks clear hierarchy in a way that breaks the premium, uncluttered brand bar.

checks.description: A human design check remains the final manual step after this gate and brand QA.
checks.rule: Fail when the asset is treated as publish-ready without a human design sign-off. Passing this gate and brand QA does not replace the manual check.

checks.description: The gate returns a binary verdict with a structured fix list on fail.
checks.rule: Result is pass only when every check passes; otherwise fail with one fix item per failing check, each naming the check, the quoted or described element, and the required change.
